The image presents two line plots. 

The first plot illustrates the relationship between $\alpha$ and BLEU. The x-axis represents $\alpha$, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents BLEU, with a linear scale ranging from 28.0 to 28.5. The plot features a single blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 28.0 BLEU when $\alpha$ is 0.1, increasing to around 28.3 BLEU at $\alpha$ 0.3, peaking at approximately 28.6 BLEU at $\alpha$ 0.5, then decreasing to about 28.4 BLEU at $\alpha$ 0.7, and finally dropping to around 28.1 BLEU at $\alpha$ 0.9.

The second plot shows the relationship between $p$ and BLEU. The x-axis represents $p$, with a linear scale ranging from 0.05 to 0.45 and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents BLEU, with a linear scale ranging from 28.0 to 28.5. This plot also features a single blue line with circular markers, beginning at approximately 28.3 BLEU when $p$ is 0.05, rising to around 28.5 BLEU at $p$ 0.15, then declining to about 28.4 BLEU at $p$ 0.25, increasing to approximately 28.5 BLEU at $p$ 0.35, and ending at around 28.4 BLEU at $p$ 0.45.
